top_categories.workout_context: Suzuka 8 Hours Enduro's closed racing circuit forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 144 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Suzuka 8 Hours Enduro's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.
At mile 60 of 144, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
When someone attacks on closed racing circuit, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Suzuka 8 Hours Enduro, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
2-minute all-out efforts on closed racing circuit. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Suzuka 8 Hours Enduro's closed racing circuit rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Suzuka 8 Hours Enduro. Train it until it feels boring.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Suzuka 8 Hours Enduro's closed racing circuit actually does to you.
Smooth pedaling at 144 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.
At Suzuka 8 Hours Enduro, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
144 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Suzuka 8 Hours Enduro’s 144 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Highly technical terrain at Suzuka 8 Hours Enduro demands practice on similar surfaces. Ride closed racing circuit at race-day cadence weekly. Practice cornering, descending, and power delivery on unstable surfaces. Dial in tire pressure before race week — 5 PSI wrong costs you 15+ minutes over 144 miles.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and Durability to prepare you for 144 miles of closed racing circuit in Suzuka Circuit, Mie Prefecture, Japan.
